label: Portuguese
source_guidance: Interpret Portuguese tense, omitted subjects and differences in forms of address. Do not infer character identity from grammatical gender.
target_guidance: Use natural Portuguese with consistent forms of address, tense, gender/number agreement and the selected regional usage.
punctuation_rule: Follow Portuguese punctuation and quotation conventions. Preserve accents, nasal marks and symbol pairing.
title_rule: Use conventional Portuguese titles and section labels.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
